question: Select the synonym of Vigilant.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Alert**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Vigilant"** means carefully watching for possible danger or difficulties; being alert and attentive to surroundings. (सजग)
 
 
• **Example:** The security guard remained vigilant throughout the night to ensure no intruders entered the premises.
 
 
• **"Alert"** means being watchful and ready to respond to any potential problems or situations. (चौकस)
 
 
• **Example:** Drivers must stay alert while driving, especially on busy roads.
 
 
• Hence, "Alert" is the synonym of "Vigilant."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Alert**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inattentive** (असावधान): Not paying attention or being careless.
 
 
• **Example:** The inattentive student missed important details during the lecture.
 
 
 
• **Sleepy** (नींद का): Feeling tired and wanting to sleep.
 
 
• **Example:** After working late at night, she felt sleepy the next morning.
 
 
 
• **Careless** (लापरवाह): Showing a lack of attention or concern.
 
 
• **Example:** He lost his phone due to his careless attitude towards his belongings.
